decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the crossover is used

Condition : 4 - The access shall not be formed until the front boundary walls shown on the drawings hereby approved has been constructed and the walls shall be permanently retained. The brick pier adjacent to the proposed parking space shall not exceed 1 metre in height. The remainder of the wall shall not exceed 600mm in height. The wall shall be constructed in brickwork to match the front of the house.
description: Construction of a means for access for vehicles
